name: Malaak Video Maker
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg imagemagick && pip install -r requirements.txt
postStartCommand: python scripts/make_config.py && nohup python -m streamlit run webui/Main.py --server.port 8501 --server.headless true --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false --browser.gatherUsageStats false > /tmp/streamlit.log 2>&1 &

PEXELS_API_KEY.description: Optional free Pexels key for stock videos

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional Gemini key for AI scripts
